figurative_meaning_en: To waver or beat around the bush; to show partiality or bias
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সবসময় উনিশ-বিশ করে, কখনো সোজা সিদ্ধান্ত নেয় না।
বিচারকটি উনিশ-বিশ করলেন বলে সবাই অসন্তুষ্ট হল।
example_sentences_in_english: He always does the nineteen-twenty thing and never makes a straight decision.
The judge showed bias by playing favorites, leaving everyone dissatisfied.
note: This idiom originates from the idea of counting unevenly (19-20) to favor one side, common in everyday Bengali colloquialism.
